children: Aperture AC agreed to acquire Atlantic HPC for a $150.0 million equity consideration and expects the combined company to list on Nasdaq as Atlantic HPC Corp.
Aperture AC will issue 15,000,000 shares (valued at $10.00 each) to Atlantic stockholders for a $150M pre-money equity value.
Atlantic stockholders may receive up to 6,000,000 earnout shares tied to an operational lease milestone and two VWAP price targets ($12.50, $15.00).
Transaction provides up to $102M gross proceeds from Aperture’s trust (0% redemptions assumed) and pro forma cash of $97M.
Pro forma enterprise value is $227M and combined company ownership: Atlantic ~46%, Aperture public and sponsor the remainder (0% redemptions case).
Atlantic brings 98 MW utility-approved capacity (51 MW operating, 47 MW under development), FY2026A revenue $28.6M and Adjusted EBITDA $4.4M.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Aperture AC to acquire Atlantic HPC in $150M stock deal, combined pro forma EV $227M
